readings: Match each conservation record to its site by site code, and drop records with no matching site. Under each site health and safety status (`healtheval`), with a missing status as its own group, count every conservation record, so a site with several records counts once per record. Work out each status's share of the sum of those counts. Then take only the statuses whose share is above the average share across all statuses, and return one summary row with the average count, the average share, and the average amount by which the share exceeds the average share. Don't round.
queries:
WITH status_counts AS (
    SELECT s.healtheval, COUNT(*) AS record_count
    FROM scanconservation AS c
    JOIN sites AS s ON s.zoneregistry = c.zoneref
    GROUP BY s.healtheval
),
shares AS (
    SELECT record_count,
           1.0 * record_count / SUM(record_count) OVER () AS share
    FROM status_counts
),
compared AS (
    SELECT record_count,
           share,
           AVG(share) OVER () AS average_share
    FROM shares
)
SELECT AVG(record_count) AS average_count,
       AVG(share) AS average_share,
       AVG(share - average_share) AS average_excess_share
FROM compared
WHERE share > average_share
